```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

counts <- read_tsv(params$counts, show_col_types = FALSE)
tpm    <- read_tsv(params$tpm,    show_col_types = FALSE)
meta   <- read_tsv(params$samples, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## 1. 本次运行的输入

报告不重述"我大概用了什么"，而是把**实际读到的文件**写进来——
路径由 Snakemake 通过 `-P` 传入，因此这一段永远和真实运行一致。

```{r inputs}
knitr::kable(meta, caption = "Sample sheet actually used in this run")
```

## 2. 定量结果概览

```{r overview}
libsize <- counts |>
  pivot_longer(-transcript, names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(total_reads = sum(count),
            detected = sum(count > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(meta |> select(sample, condition), by = "sample")

knitr::kable(libsize, caption = "Library size and detected transcripts")
```

```{r libsize-plot, fig.cap="Assigned reads per sample"}
ggplot(libsize, aes(x = sample, y = total_reads, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Assigned reads", fill = "Condition") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r pca, fig.cap="Sample clustering on log2(TPM + 1)"}
# 只用 base R + tidyverse，不引入 envs/report.yaml 之外的依赖
mat <- tpm |> column_to_rownames("transcript") |> as.matrix()
mat <- log2(mat + 1)
mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, var) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
pc  <- prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE)
as_tibble(pc$x[, 1:2], rownames = "sample") |>
  left_join(meta |> select(sample, condition), by = "sample") |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, colour = condition, label = sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "Condition") +
  theme_bw()
```

## 3. 阈值与参数记录（不可省略）

本讲无独立统计要点，但**报告必须保留前序分析用过的全部阈值**——
